name: advance-codex
description: Capability plugin for strengthening Codex skills, plugins, token-efficient writing, and technical instruction clarity.

interface.shortDescription: Strengthen skills, plugins, and instruction clarity.
interface.longDescription: Provides skills for shaping reusable Codex skills, packaging coherent plugins, applying token-efficient writing, and improving technical instructions with ASD-STE100 clarity principles. English vocabulary guidance is separate from general principles; formal compliance requires the applicable standard. Preserve correctness, meaning, verification, authority, and safety.
defaultPrompt: Use $advance-codex:plugin-creator to package a plugin and define the right bundled surfaces.
Use $advance-codex:skill-creator to design a reusable Codex skill with the right references, guardrails, and description trigger metadata.

Use $advance-codex:optimize-token to apply a token-efficient style across responses, progress and status notes, reasoning and decision wording, and durable documents while preserving correctness, meaning, verification, authority, required structure, exact literals, language, and safety.

Use $advance-codex:asd-ste100 to write or review technical instructions, agent instructions, skills, and operating procedures. Apply clarity principles in the requested language; use its references for English vocabulary and formal compliance evidence.
